helperCorrections.originalFailure: phase2 gate negative 'missing required key on AbsentCapability' refused at ADM-TYPE instead of ADM-CLOSED. The first draft _adm_type type-checked every DECLARED key whether present or not, so a popped key read as JSON null and failed the type gate. Preserved failing assertion text: 'gate negative reached wrong gate: missing required key on AbsentCapability :: ADM-TYPE vs ADM-CLOSED' (phase2 failures: 1).
helperCorrections.kitSelector: docs/coop/design-corrections/native/capability-manifest-domains.v2.json#/admission/ADM-TYPE ('Every scalar is admitted by EXACT JSON TYPE before its content is compared') and #/admission/ADM-CLOSED ('A RECORD declares a KEY SET: it carries EXACTLY that key set, each key exactly once, with no undeclared member')
helperCorrections.correction: ADM-TYPE now types only DECLARED keys that are PRESENT; an absent required key and an undeclared key are both ADM-CLOSED faults. After the correction the negative refuses at ADM-CLOSED / RECORD_KEY_SET_NOT_EXACT with missing=['deficiency'], and phase2 failures: 0.
helperCorrections.classification: helper bug with a precise existing normative answer -- NOT a design gap

notes: Capability-manifest admission executed BEFORE encoding: admit() raises at a gate and never calls cve1(), so an inadmissible manifest has no committedBytes and no capabilityManifestId to quote. Two independently chosen manifests (a syntax-only provider set and a TypeScript+Rust set) admitted with measured committedBytes hex, committedBytesSha256 and capabilityManifestId; CVE1 decode round-trip and byte-identical re-encode measured; a single-field mutation (profile) moves the id while an identical re-encode reproduces it. 18 per-gate negatives each recording the first observed refusal boundary and an explicit masking statement: ADM-TYPE (4), ADM-CLOSED (3), ADM-DOMAIN (5, including a rung of ANOTHER relation's ladder which a flat rung vocabulary would have admitted, and resolution-incomplete which is a legitimate DeficiencyV2 member but not a member of the inherited five-member capability-manifest deficiency domain), ADM-ORDER (4, including a duplicate treated as an ordering violation), plus the complete four-entry ADM-ORDER violation list emitted in the declared traversal order and the admission-precedes-encoding control. The selected successor registry's declared scope recorded: only RELATION-DOMAIN-V2 (13 = 12 inherited + unresolved-edge) and RELATION-LADDER-DOMAIN-V2 are widened; platform, deficiency, coverage-state and declared-OPEN positions keep inherited membership, and a PLATFORM-ID-DOMAIN-V1 member grants no platform support.
